title: Acme Bearings metallurgical re-cert (batch >= 24Q2)
description: Issue supplier hold on Acme Bearings AB-7821 bearing race batches pre-24Q2; require metallurgical re-cert on bearing race surface finish + carbide distribution per AS9100 corrective-action loop. Applied to BE-4 production effective 23Q4; propagation review for BE-3 / NG not completed.

title: Reinforce Acme re-cert sweep + LOX cleanliness inline check
description: Tighten incoming inspection on Acme Bearings AB-7821 to 100% race surface finish + carbide check until 3 consecutive batches pass. Add inline LOX feedline particulate witness sample at every hot-fire. Applied to BE-4 only; BE-3 / NG propagation deferred to follow-up RFA.

title: OPB injector face redesign + chamber-pressure damping margin
description: Redesigned OPB injector face for cooling-passage flow uniformity; added 6 dB margin to 1T tangential damping coefficient. Validated on unit 015.

title: Nozzle throat insert resin-density acceptance tightening
description: Tightened Vector Nozzle resin density acceptance from LCL to LCL+10% of range until process capability returns to >1.5 Cpk on 6 lots.

title: MOV actuator pilot-pressure validation step
description: Added MOV actuator pilot-pressure 5-bar bias check to acceptance flow for Titan Valve MOV.

title: Northstar gimbal actuator seal-lot re-qual
description: Reject affected gimbal actuator seal lot; require Northstar to re-qual seal lot with two consecutive in-house TVC sweeps.

title: Dome forging eddy-current acceptance protocol
description: Documented eddy-current re-scan procedure + grind-blend acceptance for dome-surface linear indications.

title: Witness-sample particulate trend escalation criterion
description: Add 30-day rolling mean trend escalation criterion to particulate witness sample data review.

title: Summit Injector element-47 LCL inspection gate
description: Add 100% element-47 inspection gate to injector incoming for next 6 batches.

title: Titan Valve helium leak-test bench standardization
description: Calibrate Titan Valve helium leak test bench against NIST-traceable reference at next maintenance interval.

title: Horizon Ceramic deposition fixture maintenance protocol
description: Documented quarterly deposition fixture maintenance protocol with thickness validation per article.

title: Filament-winding tension control loop tuning
description: Tune Pacific Pressurant filament-winding tension control loop after process drift recurrence.

title: Vector Nozzle corner-of-print acceptance rework
description: Tighten corner-of-print resin density acceptance until process capability Cpk returns >1.5 on 6 lots.

title: Ironwood Cryo prevalve solenoid lot quarantine
description: Quarantine prevalve solenoid lot; root-cause + supplier audit before release of next shipment.

title: MFV seat rework + acceptance criterion update
description: Document MFV seat rework procedure + tighten acceptance from 10 to 6 sccm seat leakage.

title: Aerojet second-stage liner mandrel offset standard
description: Document Aerojet second-stage liner mandrel offset standard and add inspection gate.

title: Atlas Tankage weld-procedure qualification refresh
description: Refresh weld-procedure qualification on Atlas Tankage second-stage methane dome interfaces.

title: Nozzle skirt brazing process auditing
description: Vector Nozzle brazing audit + Y-axis fixture refurbishment.

title: FAA NS-23 corrective-action package (21 actions)
description: Closed FAA NS-23 corrective action plan covering 21 actions across hardware, organization, and process: nozzle fatigue analysis update, operating-temperature characterization, manufacturing verification, plus organizational accountability for engineering / mission-assurance change-control. Return-to-flight on NS-24 Dec 19 2023.

title: Docking ring fastener tension monitoring
description: Sigma Fasteners receiving audit; capsule docking ring fastener tension monitoring during build flow.

title: A286 fastener torque scatter control
description: Tighten Sigma Fasteners torque scatter acceptance + add lot-level retention check.

title: Lakeside FPGA configuration patch validation
description: Patch validated with Lakeside Avionics; rolled into thrust-chamber telemetry conditioner configuration baseline.

title: Ironwood Cryo seat surface acceptance protocol
description: Document cosmetic surface acceptance protocol for cryogenic prevalve seats during receiving.

title: Merlin Seals trend register escalation criteria
description: Add trend register escalation criteria for sub-reject helium leak measurements on interpropellant seals.

title: Pacific Pressurant batch annotation policy
description: Annotate Pacific Pressurant helium pressurant composite-overwrap bottle lots that exceed 4 deg thermal cycle deviation; trend pile for monthly review.
